hook_text: 08:45 to 14:15 is 5 hours 70 minutes? Not on any clock.
clip_script: Fun day in eMalahleni! Oranges: 2,5 kg is 2 500 g, times 1 000. Water cooler: 20 litres fills 100 cups of 200 ml. Fun day from 08:45 to 14:15: count on, 5 hours 30 minutes, not 70! Sack race times in order: the median is 16 seconds. Money box: R12 485 minus R4 790 is R7 695 profit. One fifth for the sports fund. Ready for the test!
visual_style: A colourful school field with a fruit stall, a water cooler, sack racers, a stopwatch and a tally board, with numbers popping up beside each.
mood: Upbeat and festive, like the last week of the school year.
pacing: A quick tour of the field, one skill at each stop, ending at the money box.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make your own revision checklist for the test.
